title: Defects escape to production
signal: Recurring user reports or late discoveries
investigate: Trace a bounded sample: expected behavior, introduction mechanism, detection opportunity, tested build and release decision.
action: Agree one specific protection around a confirmed escape mechanism; verify it with the current tester and developers.
proof: Implemented control, current verification and later recurrence review across comparable release cohorts.

title: Requirements change or remain ambiguous
signal: Different interpretations, rework or late acceptance disputes
investigate: Compare source revisions, rules, exceptions, decisions and the timing of changes.
action: Resolve the essential uncertainty before affected implementation and review representative examples with the decision owner.
proof: Confirmed rule/change, real chronology and cases with independent expected results.

title: Useful feedback arrives too late
signal: Large queues, last-minute testing or repeated waiting
investigate: Observe real work arrival, WIP, build/data readiness, blocked periods and available validation time.
action: Pilot a smaller verifiable slice, earlier collaboration or a specific readiness correction according to the observed bottleneck.
proof: Actual timestamps, explicit waiting work and control evidence from the changed delivery slice.

title: Integrations fail unpredictably
signal: Retries, partial results, duplicates or provider-specific failures
investigate: Inspect contracts, identity, pagination, limits, mappings, ordering and actual persisted effects.
action: Define provider-specific required failure/recovery protections and verify them in an authorized controlled environment.
proof: Contract/revision, request/response, recovery result and consistent downstream state.

title: Data cannot be trusted
signal: Conflicting reports, wrong derived values or migration discrepancies
investigate: Confirm grain, schema, mappings, precision, time, null semantics and independent expected values.
action: Trace a representative source change through transformation/persistence to the actual consumer; reconcile aggregate and row-level results.
proof: Reviewed query, snapshot, expected/actual differences and source-to-outcome lineage.

title: Automation gives noisy or false confidence
signal: Flaky results, skipped checks, brittle suites or green builds with missing evidence
investigate: Inspect assertion value, isolation, fixtures, retries, quarantine, runner exits and actual gate enforcement.
action: Stabilize a small set of important protections at the lowest effective layer and prove required failures block progression.
proof: Reviewed assertions, first-attempt/retry records, safe negative gate test and named maintenance owner.

title: QA capability needs to grow
signal: Unclear standards, overloaded ownership or dependence on one experienced person
investigate: Review current work samples, reasoning, capacity, knowledge concentration and decision ownership.
action: Agree proportionate standards; pair on one important scenario, then have the tester lead and explain subsequent evidence.
proof: Revised work samples, explicit responsibilities and observable independent judgment.

title: Release decisions lack a clear basis
signal: Conflicting opinions, activity counts or unrecorded acceptance of risk
investigate: Reconcile actual build/scope, agreed gates, stale results, required acceptance and operational prerequisites.
action: Make essential failed/missing protection explicit; present a supported recommendation, next action and actual decision owner.
proof: Gate-level evidence, residual risks and a human decision record separate from QA recommendation.
